description: Car Wash is a satisfying simulation game where you transform dirty, mud-caked cars into sparkling clean vehicles. Foam, scrub, rinse, and polish each car to perfection. Different cars arrive with different levels of dirt — from light dust to full off-road mud. Upgrade your car wash equipment with better soap, power washers, and polishing tools. The before-and-after satisfaction of seeing a filthy car become showroom-shiny is deeply rewarding. Relaxing and satisfying gameplay for all ages.
shortDescription: Transform filthy cars into sparkling clean vehicles — satisfying and relaxing!
controls: Click and drag tools to apply foam, scrub, rinse, and polish. Follow the order for best results.
tips: Always start with foam — it loosens dirt for easier scrubbing
Use the power washer for tough mud spots
Polishing after washing gives bonus tips

title: Steal Brainrots Multiplayer
description: Steal Brainrots Multiplayer is a quirky strategy defense game where you collect bizarre 'brainrot' creatures and defend your base from opponents. Deploy your brainrots strategically — each type has unique abilities for attack, defense, or support. The multiplayer format means you're always facing creative human strategies. Build your army, manage resources, and time your attacks to overwhelm enemy defenses. The absurd premise and colorful character designs give the game a distinct personality.
shortDescription: Quirky multiplayer strategy — deploy bizarre creatures and defend your base!
controls: Click to select and deploy units, drag to position them strategically on the field
tips: Mix offensive and defensive units — a balanced army beats a specialized one
Watch what your opponent builds and counter accordingly
Resource generation units pay for themselves over time

title: Five Nights at Poppy
description: Five Nights at Poppy is a spine-chilling survival horror game inspired by the legendary FNAF series. You're the night guard at a creepy facility where animatronic characters roam freely after dark. Monitor security cameras, manage limited power, and close doors at the right moment to survive until 6 AM. Jump scares, atmospheric tension, and strategic resource management make this one of the most intense horror experiences in your browser.
shortDescription: Survive 5 nights of animatronic terror — the ultimate browser horror game!
controls: Mouse to interact with cameras and doors. Manage power carefully — if it runs out, you're defenseless.
tips: Don't keep doors closed all night — power runs out fast
Check cameras in a pattern: left door, right door, stage
Audio cues warn you before animatronics reach your door

title: FNF Funk 3D
description: FNF Funk 3D brings the viral Friday Night Funkin' rhythm battle to life in gorgeous 3D. Face off against iconic characters in musical showdowns where timing is everything. Press arrow keys in sync with the beat to outperform your opponent. The game features multiple songs, difficulty levels, and the charismatic art style that made FNF a global phenomenon. Catchy original soundtrack included!
shortDescription: The viral rhythm battle game in 3D — press arrows to the beat and win!
controls: Arrow Keys to hit notes in time with the music. Match the beat pattern to outperform your opponent.
tips: Watch the arrow indicators, not your character
Practice easier songs first to learn the rhythm patterns
Headphones help — audio timing is everything

title: Velocity Rush
description: Velocity Rush is a lightning-fast 3D parkour game where speed is everything. Race through neon-drenched obstacle courses at breakneck speeds, dodging barriers and hitting boost pads. The game's momentum-based movement system rewards players who maintain flow — one mistake kills your speed. Global leaderboards track the fastest times, fueling fierce competition. The pulsing electronic soundtrack syncs with your movements for an immersive speed-running high.
shortDescription: Lightning-fast 3D parkour — maintain flow, break records, feel the rush!
controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, Shift to slide. Maintain momentum through obstacles for speed boosts.
tips: Sliding preserves momentum better than jumping in most situations
Memorize obstacle patterns — reacting is slower than anticipating
Hug inside corners for the shortest racing line

title: Stickman GTA City
description: Stickman GTA City combines the open-world chaos of GTA with charming stickman visuals. Explore a sprawling stickman metropolis, steal vehicles, complete missions, and cause mayhem. The game features a variety of vehicles from bicycles to helicopters, a weapon arsenal from pistols to rocket launchers, and a wanted system that escalates as you cause more destruction. The physics-based ragdoll animations add hilarious slapstick comedy to every crash and explosion.
shortDescription: Open-world stickman chaos — steal cars, shoot, and explore a massive city!
controls: WASD to move, Mouse to aim/shoot, E to enter vehicles, F to interact
tips: Steal faster vehicles for quick getaways from police
Use rooftops to lose helicopter pursuit
Complete side missions for extra cash and weapon upgrades

title: Stickman Destruction
description: Stickman Destruction is a hilarious physics sandbox where you smash, crash, and destroy stickman ragdolls in creative and brutal ways. Launch stickmen from cannons, drop them from heights, run them over, or blow them up. Each level presents a new destruction scenario with a target score to beat. The realistic ragdoll physics create endlessly entertaining — and laugh-out-loud funny — results. A perfect stress-relief game.
shortDescription: Smash and crash ragdoll stickmen in hilarious physics destruction!
controls: Click and drag to interact with objects and stickmen. Each level has unique destruction mechanics.
tips: Experiment with different angles and power levels for maximum destruction
Chain reactions score the most points
Some objects are more destructive than others — find them

title: Masked Forces Zombie Survival
description: Masked Forces Zombie Survival is a cooperative FPS where you and other players fight against endless waves of zombies. Team up, share ammo, and watch each other's backs in dark, atmospheric maps. Multiple zombie types — from slow shamblers to fast sprinters and explosive varieties — keep you on your toes. Upgrade your weapons between waves and set up defensive positions. Communication and teamwork are essential for survival.
shortDescription: Co-op zombie FPS — team up, shoot zombies, and survive the apocalypse!
controls: WASD to move, Mouse to aim/shoot, R to reload, E to interact/pick up items
tips: Stick together — lone wolves die fast in co-op mode
Headshots save ammo and kill zombies faster
Share ammo with teammates who are running low

title: Survival Craft
description: Survival Craft is an expansive sandbox survival game where you mine, craft, build, and fight to thrive in a block-based wilderness. Gather wood, stone, and rare ores. Craft tools, weapons, and armor. Build shelters to survive the night when dangerous creatures emerge. Explore deep caves for diamonds and ancient treasures. The game features a day/night cycle, hunger management, and a massive crafting tree that keeps you progressing for hours.
shortDescription: Mine, craft, build, and survive in this block-based sandbox world!
controls: WASD to move, Mouse to mine/place blocks, E for inventory, Space to jump
tips: Your first day: punch trees, make a crafting table, build a dirt shelter
Mine at lower depths for rare ores like diamonds and gold
Always carry a bed to skip dangerous nights

title: Geometry Vector
description: Geometry Vector is a hypnotic rhythm-based arcade dodger set in a neon geometric void. Guide your vector ship through pulsing obstacles that move in sync with an electrifying electronic soundtrack. The game demands razor-sharp reflexes as the speed increases and patterns become more complex. Visual and audio cues work together to create a flow state where you're reacting on instinct. Comparable to Geometry Dash but with its own unique vector aesthetic.
shortDescription: Hypnotic rhythm dodger — weave through neon obstacles to the beat!
controls: Click or tap to change direction. Time your moves with the beat for bonus points.
tips: Listen to the music — obstacle patterns sync with the beat
Stay calm when speed increases — panicking causes mistakes
Use peripheral vision to see upcoming obstacles while focusing on your vector

title: Pinball Simulator
description: Pinball Simulator recreates the magic of classic arcade pinball machines in stunning 3D. Launch the ball, hit the flippers, and rack up points across a beautifully designed table with ramps, bumpers, spinners, and multiball modes. Chase high scores and unlock table secrets.
shortDescription: Authentic 3D pinball with realistic physics and a beautifully designed table!
controls: Left/Right Arrow or A/D for flippers, Down/S to launch ball. Time flipper hits precisely.

Don't flip both flippers at once — it leaves the center open
Learn each table's secret modes for massive bonus scores

title: Draw Here
description: Draw Here is a creative physics puzzle where you draw shapes to guide bouncing balls into target zones. shortDescription: Draw shapes to guide balls — a creative physics puzzle for all ages!
controls: Click and drag to draw lines and shapes. Your drawings become physical objects that guide the balls.
tips: Think like a mini-golf designer — curves and angles matter
Test your drawing before committing — the undo button is your friend
Sometimes the simplest funnel works better than an elaborate contraption

title: Nova Craft
description: Nova Craft is an innovative merge-crafting clicker game where you combine elements to discover new items. Start with basic elements like fire, water, earth, and air. shortDescription: Merge elements to discover hundreds of items in this addictive crafting clicker!

The catalog hints at undiscovered combinations
Focus on one category at a time for efficient progression

shortDescription: Run, jump, flip, and dive — perform outrageous stunts into the water!

Enter the water vertically for a perfect entry bonus
Each diving spot has different heights — learn the timing for each

title: Skibidi Toilet IO
description: Skibidi Toilet IO is the wildly popular multiplayer arena battler based on the viral YouTube series that has billions of views. Stay near the center to avoid being pushed out
Watch for weakened opponents to eliminate

title: Drift Rider
description: Drift Rider is a smooth 3D drifting experience focused on precision and style. Take your tuned sports car through winding mountain roads and industrial circuits. Upgrade tires first for better grip control

description: Crazy Karts is a multiplayer kart racing game with chaotic power-ups and colorful tracks. Choose your kart, pick a wild track, and race against players worldwide. Build streaks for score multipliers
Watch the wind indicator on outdoor levels

title: City Stunts
description: Hit massive ramps and perform car acrobatics across an open stunt city. String flips, spins, and jumps for combo scores.
shortDescription: Massive ramps and car acrobatics — chain stunts for huge scores!
controls: WASD to drive, Space for handbrake, hit ramps for airtime stunts.
tips: Speed is everything on ramps
Rotate mid-air for combos

title: Fort Drifter
description: Drift through an abandoned military fort turned playground. Wide spaces and tight corridors create unique drifting lines.
shortDescription: Drift through an abandoned military fort playground!
controls: WASD to drive, Space for handbrake. Explore the fort.
tips: Every corner is a drift opportunity
The runway is perfect for speed drifts

title: Super Mini Racing
description: Adorable mini cars on colorful tracks with loops, jumps, and power-ups. 2-player split-screen for head-to-head racing.
shortDescription: Adorable mini cars on colorful tracks — 2-player fun!
controls: P1: WASD. P2: Arrow Keys. Collect power-ups.
tips: Power-ups change races instantly
Drift for speed boosts

title: 2 Player Crazy Racer
description: Split-screen head-to-head racing. Two players, one keyboard, wild tracks with jumps and loops. Pure competitive local multiplayer.
shortDescription: Split-screen racing — two players, one keyboard, fierce competition!
controls: P1: WASD. P2: Arrow Keys. Race to the finish!
tips: Draft behind opponents
The last corner decides most races

title: Airplane Racer
description: Race airplanes through 3D aerial courses with rings and obstacles. Full flight mechanics in racing format.
shortDescription: 3D airplane racing through aerial courses!
controls: WASD for pitch/roll, Q/E for yaw. Fly through rings.
tips: Use yaw for fine adjustments
Momentum matters

title: Motorbike Stunt Simulator
description: Perform death-defying motorcycle stunts — backflips, front flips, wheelies across massive ramps. Realistic physics make every landing count.
shortDescription: Death-defying motorcycle flips and wheelies!
controls: Arrow Keys to control bike. Lean for flips. Land cleanly.
tips: Speed + ramp angle = rotation
Start small to learn control

title: Kick the Pirate
description: Launch and smash a pirate ragdoll with cannons and explosives. Hilarious physics sandbox.
shortDescription: Smash a pirate ragdoll with cannons — hilarious physics!
controls: Click and drag to aim and fire weapons at the pirate.
tips: Experiment with angles
Chain explosions together

title: Rome Simulator
description: Become a gladiator in ancient Rome. Fight in the Colosseum, earn freedom, rise from slave to champion with historical weapons and armor.
shortDescription: Gladiator combat in ancient Rome — fight for freedom!
controls: WASD to move, Mouse to attack/block. Timing matters.
tips: Block before attacking
Different weapons, different reach

title: Bandits Multiplayer PvP
description: Wild West horseback archery battles. Mount up, draw your bow, and fight other players across dusty frontier towns.
shortDescription: Wild West horseback archery PvP — fight on the frontier!
controls: WASD to ride, Mouse to aim bow. Keep moving — stationary riders die.
tips: Lead your shots on moving targets
Use buildings for cover

title: Jack's Village
description: Defend a medieval village as an archer hero. Tower defense meets RPG progression. Upgrade your bow and protect the villagers.
shortDescription: Archer hero defends medieval village — RPG tower defense!
controls: Mouse to aim/shoot arrows. Upgrade between waves.
tips: Prioritize fast monsters
Fire arrows for groups

title: Highway Cars
description: Sleek endless highway driving with beautiful minimalist design. Dodge traffic, collect coins, unlock vehicles in this stylish take on the genre.
shortDescription: Stylish endless highway driving with beautiful minimalist design!
controls: Left/Right to change lanes. Up to accelerate. Dodge traffic.
tips: Smooth lane changes preserve speed
Coins appear in risky spots

title: Neon Racer
description: Synthwave motorcycle trials bathed in neon. Navigate obstacle courses with precise balance control. Retro-futuristic aesthetic.
shortDescription: Synthwave motorcycle trials — neon lights and precision balance!
controls: Up to go, Down to brake, Left/Right to lean. Balance is everything.
tips: Throttle control over speed
Lean forward on inclines

title: Crazy Moto Racing
description: Endless motorcycle highway racing. Dodge traffic, earn coins, unlock faster bikes. Exhilarating sense of speed.
shortDescription: Endless motorcycle racing — dodge traffic at high speed!
controls: Arrow Keys to steer. Near-misses give bonus points.
tips: Lanesplitting is risky but rewarding
Save for the fastest bikes

title: Mini Cars Racing
description: Tiny cars racing through giant household environments — kitchen counters, bedroom floors, garden paths. Oversized everyday objects as obstacles.
shortDescription: Tiny cars on giant household race tracks!
controls: P1: WASD. P2: Arrow Keys. Kitchen counters are race tracks.
tips: Look for shortcuts under furniture
Don't fall off edges

title: Monster Truck City Parking
description: Maneuver massive monster trucks through tight city parking. Oversized vehicles with realistic weight.
shortDescription: Park monster trucks in the city!
controls: WASD to drive monster trucks into parking spots.
tips: Use external cameras
Take wide turns

title: Crazy Car Arena
description: Car battle royale — ram opponents and survive in a shrinking arena. Power-ups and chaos.
shortDescription: Car battle royale — ram and survive!
controls: WASD to drive and ram opponents. Collect power-ups.
tips: Stay center as arena shrinks
Save boost for critical moments

title: Police Traffic
description: Police emergency response racing through city traffic. Sirens, speed, and the pressure of saving lives.
shortDescription: Police emergency racing — save lives through traffic!
controls: WASD to drive. Siren makes cars move. Reach destinations fast.
tips: Use alleyway shortcuts
Don't crash — you lose more time than speeding gains

title: Motorbike Traffic
description: High-speed motorcycle highway weaving. The bike's narrow profile lets you squeeze through impossible gaps.
shortDescription: Motorcycle highway weaving — pure arcade adrenaline!
controls: Arrow Keys to steer and accelerate. Lanesplit through traffic.
tips: Motorcycles fit through car gaps
Watch upcoming traffic, not immediately in front

title: Poly Racing Cars
description: Low-poly 3D racing with gorgeous minimalist aesthetic. Smooth controls on beautiful geometric tracks.
shortDescription: Beautiful low-poly racing with smooth controls!
controls: WASD to drive. Follow racing lines for optimal speed.
tips: Smooth inputs beat jerky ones
Racing line matters more than speed

title: Pixel Driver
description: Retro pixel-art driving through a voxel city. Nostalgic visuals with modern physics. Explore and relax.
shortDescription: Retro pixel driving through a voxel city!
controls: WASD to drive. Explore the pixel city at your pace.
tips: Explore off main roads
The pixel style hides secrets everywhere

title: F1 Drift Racer
description: Formula 1 meets drift culture. Force high-downforce F1 cars to slide through corners. Unique handling on iconic tracks.
shortDescription: F1 cars forced to drift — unique handling!
controls: Arrow Keys to steer. F1 cars resist drifting — aggressive inputs needed.
tips: Brake late and turn sharply
Smooth throttle prevents spinouts

title: Tank Racing
description: Race military tanks across rugged terrain. Heavy momentum, tread-based handling, and obstacle-crushing power.
shortDescription: Race military tanks — crush obstacles and blast through!
controls: Arrow Keys to drive. Tanks handle differently — momentum is everything.
tips: Plan corners early — tanks don't turn quickly
Use weight to push through barriers

title: Cool Brainrot Clicker
description: Meme-filled incremental clicker embracing internet brainrot culture. Absurd upgrades and satisfying progression.
shortDescription: Meme-filled clicker — absurdly addictive brainrot fun!
controls: Click to earn. Buy generators. Prestige for bonuses.
tips: Auto-clickers best early investment
Prestige when progress slows

title: Crazy Drifter
description: Extreme angle drifting with massive tire smoke. Aggressive driving rewarded — more angle, more points. Upgrade your drift machine between runs.
shortDescription: Extreme angle drifting — smoke, speed, style!
controls: WASD to drive, Space for handbrake. High angle = high score.
tips: Pin the throttle during drifts
Upgrade tires for more smoke

title: Crazy Parking Fury
description: Precision parking challenges in tight urban spots. Parallel park, reverse into garages, navigate obstacle-filled lots.
shortDescription: Precision parking — navigate the tightest spots!
controls: WASD to drive. Navigate into marked parking spots.
tips: Use camera angles to check position
Slow and steady wins

title: Powerslide Kart Simulator
description: Kart racing focused on the perfect powerslide. Master weight transfer and throttle control through colorful tracks.
shortDescription: Kart powersliding — master the perfect slide!
controls: WASD to drive, Space to powerslide. Chain slides for combos.
tips: Weight transfer initiates slides
Chain slides through corners

title: Jeep Racing
description: Off-road jeep racing across rugged terrain. Mud, rocks, hills, and jumps test your 4x4 driving skills in multiplayer.
shortDescription: Off-road jeep racing — mud, rocks, and jumps!
controls: WASD to drive. Conquer rough terrain.
tips: 4WD helps on steep climbs
Momentum is key in mud

title: Monster Truck Racing
description: Massive monster trucks crushing cars and jumping obstacles. Pure destruction racing with oversized vehicles.
shortDescription: Monster trucks crushing cars — pure destruction!
controls: Arrow Keys to drive. Crush cars for bonus points.
tips: Land jumps on all four wheels
Crushed cars give nitro

title: Monster Truck Race Arena
description: Arena monster truck racing with massive jumps and car-crushing action. Compete for the fastest lap times.
shortDescription: Arena monster truck racing — jumps, crushing, speed!
controls: Arrow Keys to race around the arena. Hit ramps for air.
tips: Line up jumps early
Crush cars in your path

title: City Police Cars
description: Play as a police officer chasing criminals through city streets. Action driving with police sirens and high-speed pursuits.
shortDescription: Police chase action — catch criminals in high-speed pursuits!
controls: Arrow Keys to drive. Chase down criminals.
tips: Use the siren to clear traffic
Box in suspects against walls

title: Futuristic Racer
description: Anti-gravity racing in a neon sci-fi world. Hover vehicles, energy boosts, and impossible tracks in the future of racing.
shortDescription: Anti-gravity sci-fi racing — the future of speed!
controls: Arrow Keys to steer. Boost through energy gates.
tips: Energy gates give speed boosts
Stay low for better control

title: Ultimate Moto
description: Physics-based motorcycle trials through challenging obstacle courses. Balance, throttle control, and precise landings.
shortDescription: Physics motorcycle trials — balance and precision!
controls: Up/accelerate, Down/brake, Left/Right lean. Balance is key.
tips: Throttle control over speed
Lean forward on inclines

title: Egg Car Racing
description: Whimsical racing where fragile egg-shaped cars compete. One crash and your egg cracks! Balance speed with survival.
shortDescription: Fragile egg cars race — don't crack under pressure!
controls: Arrow Keys to drive delicately. One crash and you crack!
tips: Speed kills — literally
Smooth driving beats fast driving

title: Monster Truck Mountain Climb
description: Climb treacherous mountain paths in a monster truck. Steep inclines, rocky terrain, and cliff edges test your driving.
shortDescription: Monster truck mountain climbing — conquer the peaks!
controls: Arrow Keys to climb. Balance throttle on steep sections.
tips: Steady throttle on climbs
Don't stop on steep inclines

title: Skateboard Marathon
description: Downhill skateboarding with tricks and multiplayer racing. Grind rails, ollie gaps, kickflip for bonus. Multiple characters to unlock.
shortDescription: Downhill skateboarding — grind, flip, and race!
controls: WASD to steer, Space to ollie, Arrow Keys for tricks.
tips: Land tricks cleanly for combos
Grind rails for speed boosts

title: Checkout Frenzy
description: Supermarket cashier simulation. Scan items, process payments, bag groceries. Keep the line moving or lose customers.
shortDescription: Supermarket cashier — scan, bag, and keep the line moving!
controls: Click items to scan, process payments, bag efficiently.
tips: Group similar items for speed
VIP customers tip more

title: Fast Food Manager
description: Build and run a fast food empire. Design your restaurant, hire staff, set prices, expand from burger joint to franchise.
shortDescription: Build your fast food empire — from burger joint to franchise!
controls: Click to place equipment, manage staff, serve customers.
tips: Kitchen layout affects efficiency
Happy staff work faster

title: Nova Clicker
description: Cosmic-themed incremental clicker. Generate energy, unlock galaxies, explore the universe. Beautiful space visuals.
shortDescription: Cosmic clicker — generate energy and explore the universe!
controls: Click to generate energy. Buy auto-generators. Prestige for cosmic bonuses.
tips: Buy auto-generators early
Prestige at 2x current energy
